question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To stick one's neck out
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To stick one's neck out"** means to take a risk, especially by stating an opinion that might not be popular or by doing something that is dangerous or risky. (जोखिम उठाना)

 
 
• **Example: **He decided **to stick his neck out** and support the controversial proposal.
 
 
 
• **"To take a risk"** refers to the act of doing something that involves danger or potential loss, but might result in a reward or benefit. (जोखिम उठाना)
 
 
• **Example: **Investing in new technology always involves** taking a risk,** but it can lead to significant profits.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that **the best expression** of the phrase **'To stick one's neck out' **is **'To take a risk'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To enjoy** (आनंद लेना): To take pleasure or satisfaction in something.

 
 
• **Example:** She loves** to enjoy** a good book on the weekends.
 
 
 
• **To resign** (त्यागपत्र देना): To leave a job or position voluntarily.
 
 
• **Example: **He decided** to resign **from his position due to personal reasons.
 
 
 
• **To bring things to notice** (ध्यान में लाना): To draw attention to something or make someone aware of it.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager asked her **to bring any issues to his notice** immediately.
 
 

39:Tbf1,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
